title: The Burning Salt
author: Jude Almeida
blurb: Juniper Whitlock, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
